name: Camel
overview: The Scriptures depict camels as valuable and versatile animals, integral to the wealth and daily life of biblical patriarchs. They were used for riding, as seen when Rebekah and her attendants rode camels to meet Isaac, and for carrying burdens, evidenced by the servant taking ten camels loaded with his master's goods. Camels also demonstrated docility, kneeling by wells to allow water drawing, and were part of the blessings bestowed by the Lord, symbolizing prosperity and provision.
